fireArrows.name: Fire Arrows
fireArrows.description: Arrows leave a brief ground fire and burn — enough to ignite oil puddles.

aegis.name: Aegis
aegis.description: Shield: every unit gains a second health pool equal to its HP. Ranged hits drain the shield first; melee, fire and acid ignore it.

golden.name: Golden Aura
golden.description: Nearby allies resist tower debuffs and take 30% less damage for 30s. Wizards cannot convert them — the ray deals damage instead.

pitchBolts.name: Pitch Bolts
pitchBolts.description: Bolts splash oil on impact (does not ignite — pair with fire arrows or a Fire Bolt).

wideBlast.name: Wide Blast
wideBlast.description: Triples splash radius (grants splash to units without it).

skyBind.name: Sky Bind
skyBind.description: Can attack ground and air units.

skyLift.name: Sky Lift
skyLift.description: Lifts this unit into the air (combat flyer).

earthbound.name: Earthbound
earthbound.description: Keeps this unit on the ground (overrides Sky Lift / natural flight).

_auto.onKill: When this unit kills, raise a {{child}}
_auto.cleave: Hits every enemy within {{radius}} (around this unit)
